report.narrative: Multiple cars collided on Patterson Way and traffic has stopped. About 2 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Caller reports a crash involving several vehicles on Douglas Way. About 1 person is hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Several people collapsed in a crowded area on Thompson Way. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet.
Fire alarm and visible fire at a warehouse on Carlson Lane. Caller thinks maybe 7 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 2 look badly hurt. Flames and smoke are visible.
Chain-reaction collision on Adams Avenue, caller is standing nearby. Caller thinks maybe 2 people are hurt but cannot be sure. 1 looks badly hurt.
Caller reports a crash involving several vehicles on Garcia Lane. About 1 person is hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. Someone is trapped.
Caller sees flames and heavy smoke from a warehouse on Rodriguez Road. About 2 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Flames and smoke are visible.
Heat and crowding at a gathering on Garrison Lane, many feel faint. About 5 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt.
Caller reports a crash involving several vehicles on Henderson Avenue. About 4 people are hurt. No one seems critical yet. Someone is trapped.
Part of a warehouse on Flores Lane has collapsed. About 5 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. Someone is trapped.
Crowd surge at an event on Lee Lane, people are on the ground. About 3 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt.
Caller sees flames and heavy smoke from a restaurant on Walker Street. About 2 people are hurt. 1 looks badly hurt. Someone is trapped. Flames and smoke are visible.

meta.description: Mixed urban mass-casualty day: crashes, fires, a collapse, a spill and a crowd event.
